Translations convert source forward/right/up to WPILib forward/left/up. Angles use source values as right-handed WPILib roll/pitch/yaw; pitch/height comments conflict with values and need calibration.

Nominal LL4 optics are a provisional choice: source header says four LL4s but a rear-camera comment says LL3G. Frame rate, latency, detection cutoff and pose-noise values are explicit simulation assumptions, not measured camera performance.
